title: Billing-Record Tolerance Allowance in Commercial Natural Gas Supply Swing Excess Corrections
content:
**Clause.** In the correction of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing excess charge line, the swing tolerance that sets the upper end of the band follows the site's billing record:

- an agreement with at least 36 energy charge lines on file and at most one swing excess charge line whose billing period start is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the correction date uses the plan's swing tolerance plus 10 percentage points;
- an agreement with at least 24 but fewer than 36 energy charge lines on file and at most one such swing excess charge line uses the plan's swing tolerance plus 5 percentage points;
- any other agreement receives no addition to the plan's swing tolerance.

Both counts are taken from the agreement's own bill lines. Every swing excess charge line of the agreement whose billing period start is later than the cut-off day counts, the line being corrected included.

## Combinations

| Energy charge lines on file | Swing excess lines in the twelve-month window | Addition to the plan's swing tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0 or 1 | 10 points |
| 36 or more | 2 or more | None |
| 24 to 35 | 0 or 1 | 5 points |
| 24 to 35 | 2 or more | None |
| 23 or fewer | Any | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- **Line count.** 35 energy charge lines with one swing excess line in the window gives 5 points; 36 lines with the same window gives 10 points; 23 lines gives no addition.
- **Window cut-off.** For a correction dated 2025-09-15 the cut-off day is 2024-09-15. A swing excess line whose billing period start is 2024-09-15 is not in the window; one starting 2024-09-16 is.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 agreement with a plan swing tolerance of 20 percent has 40 energy charge lines on file, and the line being corrected is its only swing excess line with a billing period start in the window. Its swing tolerance for the correction is 30 percent. Had a second swing excess line started inside the window, the tolerance would stay at 20 percent.
